ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sounds that alert us? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sounds that alert us.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sounds that alert us.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sounds that alert us.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sounds that alert us.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Caring for c) develop positive attitude towards things found in the home (cleani.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of water.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of water.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of water.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of water.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Conserving Light environment School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Sky its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Exploring weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
